|errata_history=Versions of [[Uh-oh! (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Uh-oh! (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 1, slip 11 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, you may ▼ Clak'dor VII, Neb Dulo, or a musician. Your musicians are power and forfeit +1 for every other musician present at the same site. If you occupy Clak'dor VII, your musicians are all destiny +2. Never Tell Me The Odds may not be played. During your control phase, you may retrieve 1 Force for each site you control with a musician. A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•11” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Uh-oh! (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata)]]): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 5 December 2004; PDF dated 12 October 2004), page 1, slip 11, on the same old slip: “Deploy on table. You may ▼ Clak'dor VII, Neb Dulo, or a musician. Your musicians are power and forfeit +1 (limit +3) for every other musician present at the same site. If you occupy Clak'dor VII, your musicians are destiny +2. Never Tell Me The Odds may not be played. During your control phase, you may retrieve 1 Force for each battleground you control with a musician. A” '''What changed:''' “Once per turn, you” became “You”; “(limit +3)” was added after “and forfeit +1”; “all” was removed; “site” became “battleground”. The slip mark at bottom right now reads “7•11a” (the first sheet: “7•11”).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 11), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Clak’dor VII, Neb Dulo, or a musician from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While you control Clak’dor VII, your musicians are power and forfeit +2. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each battleground site you control with a musician. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
